content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Lancaster

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—typically a degree plus years of documented project leadership, or equivalent experience without a degree. Granite PM Academy's advisors can help you verify you meet the threshold before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend all required sessions from anywhere—no travel to Lancaster necessary. Our active certified practitioners deliver real-world case studies and exam-aligned content. You'll earn your 35 contact hours and gain confidence in core project-management frameworks.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Once training is complete, apply directly to PMI with your education and experience documentation. Pay PMI's exam fee at that time. Granite PM Academy staff can guide you through the application process to ensure accuracy and avoid delays in approval.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice exams and focused study guides tailored to the PMP blueprint. Schedule your exam when ready. Our support extends through test day—you'll have access to instructors who understand the exam format and can answer final questions.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to the standard three-year renewal cycle. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteering, or giving back to the project-management community. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible courses to help you stay current and renew without stress.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
